subject: Automotive & EVs
title: Roads That Communicate
description: A short lesson to help you apply Roads That Communicate.

hook.text: Smart roads embed sensors and transmitters in the pavement to talk directly with passing vehicles.

buildup.text: These systems warn drivers about ice, accidents, or construction in real time, long before they can see it.

discovery.text: Vehicle-to-infrastructure, or V2I, connects traffic lights, signs, and tolls into one intelligent network.

twist.text: A smart traffic light could turn green as an emergency vehicle approaches, clearing its path automatically.

climax.text: China is building entire highways with embedded V2I—designed from scratch for autonomous vehicles.

punchline.text: Smart roads don't just carry cars—they guide them.

quiz.question: What does V2I (vehicle-to-infrastructure) enable?
options: Real-time communication between cars and road infrastructure
